answer: Accept proof-of-work shares only inside a narrow window after they are made, so a share computed last week is worthless today. An atlas drawn from memory fades, and an ivory carving cannot be rushed without cracking. The pigment of fresh paint is the proof: each share dies within seconds of its birth, so a farm cannot precompute a mountain of shares and drip them out slowly, and one machine can only make so many in time.
